title: Ronald C
content: While ice skating on a frozen basketball court at school with other kids, I fell backward and hit my head. I floated up without pain, about 500 feet above the school. I could see 100 miles. I saw snow on the roofs, antennas, and people working on my body from far below. It was very peaceful. Then I was back. There was no sense of time, so I don’t recall how long I was out.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No, Accident, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, Total calmness.
elements.At what time during the experience were: When high above, looking down at myself
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt the beauty and calm
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about myself or others, Simply peace
elements.What is your religion now?: Christian- Catholic, Not a churchgoer, but try to be kind to people.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, Silence and peace
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes, Not sure, but I am really not materialistic. Again, I was very young and it was a solo experience, no angels, etc.
elements.Did you gain information about how to li: Uncertain, I was very young, there was no depth to it. I don't think it was a very long experience. All I recall was looking down at my body and seeing four or five people around me and what they were doing. I saw a 360-degree view at perhaps 300 or 400 feet above it all.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I was very young and in a horrible place at a Catholic boarding school. Barbour Hall Military run by nuns who abused me.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I was in clear sight of all below me and up at maybe 300 feet. I could also see horizontally for endless miles. I felt no pain, only peace.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, Completely real, more real than life down there.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, No clue. It has only come up now as NDE people are speaking up. I loved the Theo and Long podcast.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes, I overdosed on heroin and was in the emergency room when my heart stopped. I saw Jesus Christ in a bright white light above and to my left.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, Very difficult as I was so young.
